data.description: Host disk filled to 100% (0 bytes available) mid-Testing stage, caused by orphaned worktree directories from earlier-session developer/tester delegations whose `git worktree remove` had failed on Windows (Invalid argument / Filename too long) -- git had unregistered them but the full node_modules/.next/.venv trees were never actually deleted from disk. This broke npm install (ENOSPC/ENOTEMPTY), corrupted package.json/package-lock.json with a partial-install diff, and blocked the tester subagent from running lint/test/e2e or committing. Orchestrator's own rm -rf attempts to clean the orphaned directories were denied by the session's Bash permission policy; resolved by asking the human operator to manually delete the orphaned worktree directories via the filesystem, freeing ~4GB. A subsequent background lint/test run was also killed once by the harness's low-memory protection, resolved by a simple retry. No data was lost; the tester's uncommitted test-file changes survived untouched in its own worktree throughout. No code or process change is proposed here beyond this log -- the standing CLAUDE.md worktree-removal-failure note (docs/01 recovery notes) already covers the root cause; this event records a case where it actually caused a full stop, not just leftover empty directories.
